comments:
Listed in the group of Phya pa (ID:3831)'s students called the "four noble ones" (jo sras mi bzhi), comprising rNgog ra mo (ID:3847), bSod nams rtse mo (ID:3838), Khu Ne tso (ID:3849), and gNyos dPal le (ID:3850).
Biographical sketch in [FDEWZ2NZ]: 289-291.
[FDEWZ2NZ]: 264 adopts the dates 1134-1170 (from the lHo rong chos 'byung) rather than the dates 1146-1182 (from the Deb ther sngon po), which [HM43XTRK] adopts.
He studied all the tantric cycles of the rNgog, and was proficient as well in Perfection of wisdom, epistemology, debate, etc.
